changelog:
Initial release of Analytics Engine: event tracking, analysis, and revenue metrics for AI agents.

- Enables event tracking, cohort retention, funnel analysis, and multi-touch attribution.
- Provides instant access to key revenue metrics (MRR, ARR, LTV, CAC).
- Real-time analytics and live monitoring supported.
- All endpoints secured via x402 payment (USDC on Base).
- Simple API for tracking and advanced analytics without third-party platforms.
summary: Event tracking, funnel analysis, cohort retention, multi-touch attribution, revenue metrics, and real-time analytics — built for AI agents.
